newsitem.title: CHINA: Erdos to issue 100 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Erdos to issue 100 mln B shares.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd, the world's biggest cashmere producer, will issue 100 million additional B shares from May 6 to 8, a company statement in the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
The shares, priced at 6.88 yuan, equivalent to $0.83, will be listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the statement said but did not say when.

After the issue, the company will have a total of 436 million shares outstanding, of which 210 million will be foreign currency B shares, accounting for 48.17 percent of the total. The remaining 51.83 percent are legal person shares, it said.
Proceeds from the issue will be used to import production equipment, enlarge sources of raw materials and invest in five cashmere makers to increase production capacity, the statement said.
China Southern Securities Co is the lead underwriter for the issue, it said.
Trading of its B shares will be suspended this morning and will resume this afternoon, the newspaper said.
Erdos B shares ended on Monday at $0.974.
